driver: issue #43 (description compression to the amended §3.5 listing-budget target)
method: HOUSECARL_SKILL_AUTHORING §6.5 fan-out, menu variant per houseCARL PR #295: one fresh-context judge per eval query (Opus, HIGH reasoning effort, no tools), each shown ONLY its single query plus the full lettered menu of all 11 NEW descriptions (anonymized, under-test skill unflagged) plus NONE, forced single pick, reasoning before verdict; one Opus adjudicator per skill scored recall/specificity from the judges' reasoning per §6.5 step 4. Judge model deliberately upgraded from PR #295's sonnet-low (maintainer decision). Contamination guard: the live install was moved aside for the fan-out window so fresh judges carried no stale skill listing. Gates: recall >= 80%, specificity >= 50%.
description_measured: Patch armor for Requiem via houseCARL — armor rating, set/part keywords, value, and tempering recipe derived from Requiem's comparable piece (part + material + light/heavy), emitted as an ESP override. Use for any ARMO record: a modded cuirass, shield, helmet, or whole set that doesn't fit Requiem's tiers. Load before the ARMO write, not after the Reqtificator caps it wrong.
adjudicator_notes: No reasoning-vs-token discrepancies; every judge's prose matched its verdict token, so no overrides applied. Recall 9/9: q1-q9 all routed to B, each explicitly identifying an ARMO record and citing B's part+material+light/heavy derivation, with G (whole-mod router) correctly rejected as over-scoped for single-record asks. Specificity 9/9: no misfires to B. Near-misses handled cleanly — q12 (fortify heavy armor ENCH/MGEF) went to E on the "B owns the ARMO record, not effect magnitude" distinction; q13/q14 (mesh weighting, beast-race ARMA coverage) went NONE on record-data-vs-asset grounds; q16 (SkyPatcher INI) and q17 (MO2 install/load order) went NONE on wrong-output-artifact and wrong-domain grounds; q18 (gameplay build advice) went NONE despite the "heavy armor" lexical lure. Description's scoping language ("modded ARMO that doesn't fit Requiem's tiers", emit ESP override) is doing the specificity work — judges cited it verbatim in four of the five NONE rows.
